sentences.en: She studies hygiene as part of her domestic science course.
sentences.zh: 她把卫生学作为家政课程的一部分来学习。

sentences.en: Are you arresting me for domestic violence? Come on, guys!
sentences.zh: 你们是因为家庭暴力逮捕我的吗？别开玩笑了！

sentences.en: Smoking is now banned on all domestic plane flights.
sentences.zh: 现在所有国内航班都禁止吸烟了。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：dom（房屋）+estic（…的）→在房子里的→家庭的
